scope: public read-only GitHub status check for PetDex Hook EOF issue and related draft PR

issue_689.title: Hook 在宿主未关闭 stdin 时持续等待，可能导致会话卡住
issue_689.reported_boundary: The native and CLI runners can continue waiting for EOF after a complete payload when the host keeps stdin open.

pr_710.title: WIP: Native bubble revamp and platform parity
pr_710.declared_scope: Native bubble presentation and platform parity; it does not claim to resolve #689.

decision: The upstream EOF behavior remains unresolved. The local bounded wrapper is a mitigation only and must not be described as an upstream fix.
